title: Add annotated context resolver index
instructions: Create references/context-resolver-index.md as an annotated routing artifact for deciding what Samantha should read first by task type. It must connect to the existing Context Resolver Principle, reduce context bloat, and keep top-level docs as pointers. Include a small initial table for high-signal routes only: brainstorm/plan, doctrine update, policy change, failed-run recovery, learning/lesson promotion, correction transcript mining, batch planning, and docs-only writer tasks. Each route should include task signal, read-first artifacts, why those artifacts matter, when not to read them, and authority limits. Add at most a minimal pointer in ARCHITECTURE.md near the Context Resolver Principle. Do not add runtime resolver code, CLI commands, tests, task templates, agent profiles, run logs, worktrees, AGENTS.md changes, remote adapters, daemon/watch behavior, dashboards, routine triggers, hidden memory, automatic context loading, automatic mutation, or broad repository indexing. Run the verify command before final response. End with exactly one HARNESS_RESULT line.
expectedCommitSubject: docs: add annotated context resolver index
